name: Log House Foods
old_description: Family-owned since 1947, Log House Foods is a leading manufacturer, marketer, and distributor of branded and private label food products. Built on a foundation of strong relationships, we develop innovative foods and deliver unparalleled solutions and service with an established history committed to quality for over 70 years. As our work in this increasingly complicated food environment continues to evolve and change, we leverage our time-tested expertise to work on customized solutions for your business.
about:
Log House Foods, a family-owned food manufacturer, has operated from Plymouth, Minnesota since its founding in 1947. The company began in the confectionery business and has since expanded to two facilities in the Minneapolis metro area — Plymouth and Bloomington — while remaining under family ownership.

The company produces a wide range of branded and private-label food products, including confectionery coatings and barks under the CANDIQUIK and Plymouth Pantry names, baking chips, cocoa powders, coconut flakes, and a better-for-you line featuring WholeMe granola clusters and Mill City Organics organic products. It also manufactures candy such as Mighty Malts malted milk balls, Haviland thin mints, chocolate-covered nuts, and bridge mixes, plus organic coconut and avocado oils and coconut sugars. Capabilities span research and development (national brand matching, trend-forward recipe development, functional food formulation), design and packaging (in-house creative team, vertical integration in plastics and labeling, shelf-life maximization), and manufacturing with fully automated production lines and continuous process improvement.

Log House Foods serves retailers and brands seeking private-label or co-manufacturing partners across baking, snacking, confectionery, better-for-you, and organic food categories. Its customer base includes national brands looking for product matching and trend-driven formulation, as well as companies needing customized packaging and certification support.

The company emphasizes its nimble, family-business approach combined with large-scale capabilities, highlighting GFSI-certified facilities, RSPO-certified sustainable oils, and vertically integrated supplier relationships as key differentiators.
